Select IC50 activity rows for human sodium channel protein type 5 subunit alpha (CHEMBL1980). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join docs on activities.doc_id. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL1980 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
